_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC, hand-generated (no live SCANsat capture available), replace with a real capture when SCANsat is installed and a body scanned. Structured asymmetrically (south ice cap > north, west-hemisphere ocean, mountains patch, ~46% scanned swath) so an N/S axis flip or wrong longitude offset is visible in the render. Cell order idx=ilon*180+ilat per scanDecode. The scan MASK is deliberately not fed here: it reaches the minimap through the registered fog-reveal sources rather than a topic this widget subscribes to, so an emit of it is dropped and the harness says so. `scansat.scanningVessels` is a TOP-LEVEL key rather than a stream emit because the widget still reads it through the legacy `"data"` DataSource (`useScanLayers.ts`'s `useScanningVessels`); an emit of it on the stream is dropped for the same reason, unsubscribed. Move it back into `_stream.emits` the day that read migrates.
